purpose: Re-express the R31 checkpoint-comparison behavior results on the SAME basis as the R29 report section 2: 52 functional tasks (kind != profile) and 9 known diagnostic profile prompts (kind == profile), strict and semantic reported separately, instead of the pooled 61-task totals.
method: functional_strict = rows with kind != profile and strict_task_passed true in semantic-rescore-v2.json (equals summary.json task_passed on the same rows); functional_semantic_correct = kind != profile and semantic_correct true; unassessable = kind != profile and semantic_assessed false; diagnostic_passed = kind == profile rows with summary task_passed true. Revalidated by applying the same function to the R29 arms, which reproduces the published R29 numbers exactly.

published_r29_vs_r31.difference: +1 functional strict, +3 diagnostic passed, semantic identical
published_r29_vs_r31.interpretation: Same checkpoint package, different image (R29 to R31) and T1/top_p 0.95 sampling, one boot per arm. Run-to-run variance is expected on a small bounded suite; this is not a regression claim in either direction.

scope: Bounded synthetic suite, not a general model ranking. Strict format compliance and semantic correctness reported separately; diagnostic profile prompts kept out of the functional 52.
